'''2007 Endor Regionals Andrew Taylor LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Taylor]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
